D5/S3/Geometry/ProbabilityTransport/Weig.name: AlternatingArrayContraction.weighted_minors
D5/S3/Geometry/ProbabilityTransport/Weig.signature: theorem weighted_minors {n : ℕ} (x y z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hON : Orthonormal ℝ ![x, y, z]) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) (hpos : ∀ i j, 0 < A i j) : (∑ i, ∑ j, if i < j then A i j * Matrix.det !![x i, x j; y i, y j] ^ 2 else 0) ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, if i < j ∧ j < k then max (A i j) (max (A i k) (A j k)) * Matrix.det !![x i, x j, x k; y i, y j, y k; z i, z j, z k] ^ 2 else 0
